Gutenberg (printing press), Morse (telegraph), Bell (telephone), and Marconi (radio) all made foundational contributions to communication technology. Charles Babbage is considered the 'Father of the Computer' due to his work on the Analytical Engine, which was primarily a calculating and processing device, not a communication method in the same direct sense.

explanation: The first four tokens (BICYCLE, BINOCULARS, DUET, TWIN) are all intrinsically linked to the number two or the concept of a pair. A BICYCLE has two wheels, BINOCULARS have two lenses, a DUET involves two performers, and a TWIN is one of two identical individuals. A TRIPOD, however, is defined by having three legs.
